India braces for heavy monsoon rains and thunderstorms

Several Indian regions, including Delhi-NCR, Rajasthan, and parts of Chhattisgarh, are under weather alerts due to the monsoon's intensity. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange alert for Delhi-NCR, forecasting moderate to heavy rain with wind speeds up to 80 km/h. Other states are also anticipating heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, and strong winds, potentially leading to disruptions.
